trigger: Header inventory and fixed fits reveal STAR,SKY,NONE plus actual B-sky lines in the V2-0165 exposure; this was not assumed in the original fixed plan.
procedure: Compare sideband-subtracted native A and B profiles at each of three fixed air wavelengths. Estimate a descriptive A/B scale independently at5577 and6300; retain both as a bracket, apply each to B6363, and report residual A6363 fixed-Gaussian area. Do not treat this bracket as calibrated fiber efficiency or uncertainty interval. Do not mask the suspected particle pixels or change saved fits.
figures: Plot A/B signed residuals in ADU per line; compare scaled B6363 with A6363 and retain the narrow A excess. Show prior raw A morphology alongside if available.
interpretation: A simultaneous sky line establishes an atmospheric component along the nearby sky sightline, not a proof that all science-fiber flux has that origin. Superposed instrumental/stellar contributions remain possible; original dispositions preserved.
